mapper.select: SELECT sf.*, a.title as activity_title FROM service_footprint sf LEFT JOIN activity a ON sf.activity_id = a.id WHERE sf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sf.service_date DESC

SELECT location_name, latitude, longitude, COUNT(*) as service_count, SUM(service_hours) as total_hours FROM service_footprint WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY location_name, latitude, longitude ORDER BY service_count DESC
